summary: STIR carries PASSporTs that assert caller identity in-band within SIP, or out-of-band through a storage service. This document defines how service providers can use the out-of-band approach, which helps when the call path does not preserve SIP headers.

eli5.summary: Caller ID can be faked. When the proof cannot travel with the call, this lets the proof be left at a drop-off point for the receiver to pick up.

questions: passport out of band service providers
